heading: India General Elections 2024 highlights: 61.45% approximate voter turnout recorded today till 8 pm
paragraphs:
India General Elections 2024 highlights: Voting began at 7 am on Tuesday for the third phase of the 2024 Indian elections, encompassing 93 constituencies across 11 states and Union Territories. Key contenders include Amit Shah, Shivraj Chouhan, Dimple Yadav and Digvijaya Singh. Follow- Elections 2024: Read Elections 2024 News and Lok Sabha Election Updates

Lok Sabha Election 2024 Phase 3 Elections: Key points

• In the third phase of elections, prominent candidates include Union home minister Amit Shah, seeking re-election from Gujarat's Gandhinagar, and Union ministers Jyotiraditya Scindia, Mansukh Mandaviya and Pralhad Joshi contesting from various constituencies.

• This phase holds key implications for the political landscape, particularly in Maharashtra and Uttar Pradesh, with high-profile candidates and familial legacies at stake.

• Maharashtra's Baramati, considered a stronghold of the 'Pawar family', witnesses a significant contest between NCP founder Sharad Pawar’s daughter Supriya Sule and Sunetra Pawar, wife of Maharashtra deputy chief minister Ajit Pawar.

• The late Mulayam Singh Yadav's family is also prominent in this phase, with three members contesting. Akhilesh Yadav's wife Dimple Yadav, Akshay Yadav and Aditya Yadav are vying for seats in Uttar Pradesh.

India General Elections 2024 Live: Congress leader Surendra Singh Rajput has asked BSP chief Mayawati if she removed nephew Akash Anand as BSP coordinator under some pressure from the BJP.

"The way BSP chief Mayawati has removed her nephew Akash Anand from party coordinator post is very shocking. Did you take this step under some pressure from the BJP? Though this is an internal matter of your party, you should issue a clarification about this," said Congress leader Surendra Singh Rajput as quoted by news agency PTI.
India General Elections 2024 Live: Delhi Minister and AAP leader Gopal Rai has said that people of Delhi are angry as they (BJP) jailed Arvind Kejriwal.

"Across Delhi and country, people are raising their voice...for the past 10 years...farmers, women and tribals who were disturbed by the dictatorship of PM Modi, they are giving reply with vote. People of Delhi are angrier as they (BJP) jailed the elected Chief Minister," said Gopal Rai as quoted by news agency ANI.
India General Elections 2024 Live: BSP chief Mayawati has removed Akash Anand as National Coordinator of the party and as her successor.

BSP chief Mayawati tweeted, "I declared Akash Anand as the National Coordinator of BSP and my successor, but in the larger interest of the party and the movement, he is being separated from both these important responsibilities until he attains full maturity"

India General Elections 2024 Live: BJP national spokesperson Shehzad Poonawalla has claimed that Lalu Prasad Yadav is openly saying that Muslims should get complete reservations

"...The statements they (opposition) are giving show that they are under pressure due to the vote bank. Lalu Prasad Yadav is openly saying that Muslims should get complete reservation...," said Shehzad Poonawalla as quoted by news agency ANI.

India General Elections 2024 Live: 61.45% approximate voter turnout was recorded today till 8 pm in Phase 3 of the Lok Sabha elections 2024, as per the Election Commission of India, reported news agency ANI.

India General Elections 2024 Live: BJP candidate from Hyderabad Lok Sabha seat, Madhavi Latha has exuded confidence about her win in the constituency and the party winning 400 seat in the ongoing polls.

"Be it harsh sunlight or heavy rainfall, nothing can stop our fight for truth. We are going to win this time and hence we come out with enthusiasm. We will win Hyderabad and will cross 400 (Lok Sabha seats)," said Madhavi Latha as quoted by news agency ANI.
India General Elections 2024 Live: Polling for third phase has concluded in several states, including, Gujarat and Chhattisgarh
India General Elections 2024 Live: Punjab CM and AAP leader Bhagwant Mann is holding a roadshow in Bathinda along with party's Lok Sabha candidate Gurmeet Singh Khudian.
India General Elections 2024 Live: Union minister and BJP's candidate from Amethi, Smriti Irani has taken a dig at Congress leader Rahul Gandhi over the latter getting support from Pakistan.

"Till now I used to contest against Congress leader only, but now a Pakistani leader has said that Smriti Irani should be defeated. 'Tumse Pakistan na sambhalta, tum Amethi ki chinta karte ho'. If my voice reaches the leader of Pakistan, I want to say, this is the Amethi where PM Modi has built the factory of the AK 203 rifle, that rifle used to kill Pakistani terrorists on borders... 'chunaav chal rha hai desh me, samarthan mil rha aapko (Rahul Gandhi) videsh me'," said Smriti Irani as quoted by news agency ANI.

India General Elections 2024 Live: While addressing a public meeting in Maharashtra's Beed, Prime Minister Narendra Modi said, "In Karnataka, where OBC had 27% reservation, the Congress govt brought a 'fatwah', an order and declares all the Muslims in Karnataka as OBC. What BR Ambedkar, the Constitution, the parliament have given 27% reservations to OBC, by putting Muslims in the category of OBC, overnight, they (Congress) looted what was there for the OBC..."

India General Elections 2024 Live: While addressing a public meeting in Maharashtra's Beed, PM Narendra Modi said "Like the polling for the third phase (of Lok Sabha) elections is about to end, the hopes of the INDI-Aghadi have dashed... Modi is on a mission to make India 'viksit' (developed), and I need your blessings for this."

India General Elections 2024 Live: While addressing a public meeting in Maharashtra's Beed, PM Narendra Modi said, "An INDI alliance leader has said today that the Ram Temple (in Ayodhya) is useless. Can they use this language for any other religion? They are insulting Lord Ram and his devotees to appease their vote bank."
India General Elections 2024 Live: Prime Minister Narendra Modi is holding a Public meeting in Maharashtra's Beed.
India General Elections 2024 Live: Election Commission of India has directed social media platform X(formely Twitter) to take down animated video shared by Karnataka BJP on Muslim reservation row

India General Elections 2024 Live: Maharashtra CM Eknath Shinde has taken a dig at the state's former chief minister Uddhav Thackeray.
"Uddhav abandoned Balasaheb's ideology for greed of chair; we're taking forward his Hindutva vision," Maharashtra CM Eknath Shinde told news agency PTI.
India General Elections 2024 Live: Congress Parliamentary Party Chairperson Sonia Gandhi has said that the BJP's focus is only on gaining power at any cost.

"Today in every corner of the country, youth are facing unemployment, women are facing atrocities, Dalits, tribals, backward classes and minorities are facing terrible discrimination. This atmosphere is due to the intentions of Prime Minister Narendra Modi and the BJP. Their focus is only on gaining power at any cost. They have promoted hatred for political gain. The Congress Party and I have always fought for the progress of all, justice to the deprived and to strengthen the country...The Congress and INDIA alliance is dedicated to protecting the Constitution and democracy. Vote for Congress for a bright future for all and together let us build a strong and united India...," said Sonia Gandhi as quoted by news agency ANI.

India General Elections 2024 Live: While addressing a public meeting in Maharashtra's Ahmednagar, PM Narendra Modi said "Tweets are being made from across border to boost morale of Congress; in return Congress is giving clean chit to Pakistan on terror attacks"

India General Elections 2024 Live: While addressing a public meeting in Maharashtra's Ahmednagar, PM Narendra Modi reacted to Congress leader Vijay Wadettiwar’s recent remark that police officer Hemant Karkare was not killed by terrorist Ajmal Kasab. PM Modi said, "Congress is siding with Ajmal Kasab(terrorist)".

India General Elections 2024 Live: While addressing a public meeting in Maharashtra's Ahmednagar, PM Narendra Modi said "The expiry date of INDI alliance has been fixed for 4th June...This election is between 'Santushti-Karan' and Tushti-karan'."

India General Elections 2024 Live: While addressing a public meeting in Maharashtra's Ahmednagar, PM Narendra Modi said, "Agenda of NDA is development, poor people's welfare, national security, country's self-esteem and respect. Is Congress in a situation to talk on any of these issues?."

India General Elections 2024 Live: The Pune police booked five people in response to allegations from the NCP (Sharadchandra Pawar) that individuals linked to the Ajit Pawar-led NCP distributed cash to voters in Bhor town ahead of the Baramati Lok Sabha seat polling. A non-cognizable offence was registered against five them.
The Sharad Pawar-led NCP (SP) lodged a complaint with the Election Commission (EC) regarding the alleged money distribution. Deputy chief minister Ajit Pawar denied the accusations against his party.
The electoral battleground in Baramati sees NCP (SP) candidate Supriya Sule and Ajit Pawar-led NCP's Sunetra Pawar vying for victory as polling takes place on Tuesday.
